Field notes
Fill complete rows in a six-column well. Rotate and slide a piece, then Drop to lock it; gravity moves only when you choose Lower or Drop.
Preview three upcoming pieces. Hold exchanges one piece once per placement. Rotation may shift up to two cells sideways to fit.
Clear six rows in each of three bag-seeded studies. A blocked spawn loses. Next study advances after a clear; Restart begins the journey.

Tap named controls. Focus the board for displayed keyboard shortcuts. Escape pauses. Every action is turn-paced. Retry this study preserves earlier clears; Restart all begins at study one.

Every simulation advances only when you act. Take your time. You can inspect the board before committing, and restart any study.
